name: Annotations
description: Provides shared functionality for the Annotations suite: annotation content entities, config-entity targets and types, a target plugin system, and a management permission model.

suggests.drupal/ai: Required by annotations_docs for AI-generated documentation (chat generation via ai.provider)
suggests.drupal/diff: Suggested by annotations_audit and annotations_explorer for revision diff display
suggests.drupal/profile: Required by annotations_profile for Profile field overlay support
suggests.drupal/webform: Required by annotations_webform for Webform and WebformSubmission target support
suggests.league/commonmark: Required by annotations_docs to convert AI-generated markdown to HTML

project_description:
Annotations lets you attach structured notes to any part of a Drupal site: content types, custom entities, individual fields, vocabularies, roles, views, menus, workflows, and more. Those notes live in one place as first-class annotation content entities (fieldable, revisionable, translatable, workflow-capable) and can be surfaced wherever you need them.

The base module defines the data model — the annotation content entity, the annotation_target config entity (which entity/bundle is opted in and which of its fields are in scope), the annotation_type config entity (bundle of annotation, e.g. editorial/technical/rules), a #[AnnotationsTarget] plugin system for describing entity types, and a permission model that separates management from consumption. It ships no end-user UI itself; the suite's submodules add the annotate UI, in-context overlays, coverage auditing, JSON/MCP/Tool context delivery, AI document generation, and Obsidian/markdown export. Annotations does not touch your content model or add fields to other entities; it is a metadata layer alongside your existing setup.

tool_plugins.label: List Annotation Targets
tool_plugins.description: Returns the annotation targets configured on this site. Each target corresponds to an entity bundle (e.g. node__article, taxonomy_term__tags). Use the returned target IDs with the Get Annotations tool to fetch documentation for a specific bundle.

tool_plugins.label: Get Annotations
tool_plugins.description: Returns annotation documentation for a Drupal entity bundle as markdown. Annotations are site-specific editorial notes, field-level guidance, and rules describing how content types and fields should be used. Scope to a specific target (e.g. node__article) or omit to return all configured targets.

tool_plugins.label: Write Annotation
tool_plugins.description: Creates or updates an annotation value for a Drupal entity bundle or field. Finds the existing annotation for the given target/field/type combination and updates it, or creates a new one if none exists. Use List Annotation Targets to discover valid target IDs first.
